entries.test: Compare publicly documented ChatGPT/GPT-4 outputs with its authenticated English system instructions to determine whether outputs sometimes violate those instructions.
entries.note: The condition concerns an existing system, so this is a conditional observation rather than a conditional forecast.

entries.test: Compare the outputs recently documented by Marcus, Southen and Conrad with the alleged system prompt to determine whether a substantial portion violate its directives.
entries.note: The comparison is checkable even though the prompt's authenticity is qualified.

entries.test: Publicly documented LLM programming and debugging examples can establish whether failures arise from models failing to follow correct instructions as well as from programmers' mistakes.
entries.note: 'May or may not' describes inconsistent instruction-following in this present-tense observation. 'Frightening' is evaluative, but the debugging claim has a testable plain reading.
